title: Helpers at School — Working Together
memory_verse: "Not looking to your own interests but each of you to the interests of the others." — Philippians 2:4 (NIV)
objective: Students will learn how to be good helpers at school and follow classroom rules.
content: School is a special place where we learn together! God wants us to be good helpers at school, just like at home.
Good school helpers listen to the teacher, raise their hand, share supplies, and take turns. These things help everyone learn better!
Being a good helper also means being kind to our classmates. We can share, say nice words, and include everyone in our games.
When we follow the rules at school and help others, we are being like Jesus! Jesus was always kind and helpful to everyone He met.
activity: Role-play being a good school helper! Practice raising your hand, sharing a crayon, saying 'please' and 'thank you,' and helping a friend pick up dropped papers.
discussion: What are some school rules we follow?
How can you be kind to a classmate?
How was Jesus a good helper?
